message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Operating Expense Efficiency", "construction": "Total operating expenses (from income statement) divided by total revenues, measured over the trailing twelve months.", "rationale": "Firms with lower operating expense ratios may have better cost controls, potentially leading to higher profitability and investor re-rating.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Accruals", "construction": "Change in inventories (from balance sheet) over the past year divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "High inventory accruals can signal aggressive revenue recognition or slowing demand, which may foreshadow weaker future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Change Momentum", "construction": "Percentage change in annual dividends per share over the past three years.", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating dividend growth may be signaling strong, sustainable cash flows and commitment to shareholders.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth", "construction": "Change in current assets (from balance sheet) over the past year divided by lagged total assets.", "rationale": "Rapid asset growth can be associated with overinvestment or empire-building, which may lead to lower subsequent returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "SG&A Intensity", "construction": "Selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) expenses divided by total revenues, measured over the trailing twelve months.", "rationale": "Lower SG&A intensity may indicate more efficient operations and better margin discipline.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Relative Analyst Coverage", "construction": "Number of analyst earnings estimates for a firm divided by the median number for its industry (data from I/B/E/S or similar).", "rationale": "Stocks with less analyst attention may be more likely to be mispriced, offering higher average returns to investors who do the extra research.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Late Reporter Penalty", "construction": "Number of days between fiscal year-end and annual report (10-K) filing date.", "rationale": "Firms that delay financial reporting may have poor internal controls or negative surprises, both factors that could predict lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Purchases", "construction": "Net number of shares purchased by insiders over the prior six months, scaled by shares outstanding (data from SEC filings).", "rationale": "Insider buying may indicate undervaluation or confidence in firm prospects, while selling can signal the opposite.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Interest Coverage Change", "construction": "Change in earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) divided by interest expense, comparing the most recent year to the previous year.", "rationale": "Improvement in the ability to service debt may indicate strengthening financial health, which could lead to higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Total R&D expense over the past three years divided by average total assets, for firms that capitalize and expense R&D (where disclosed).", "rationale": "Firms investing more heavily in R&D relative to assets may generate higher innovation and long-term growth, which the market might underappreciate.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
